trust_decision.summary: Whether the bytes CachedClient.Get returns come from the same OCI digest that cosign verified: the tag is resolved to a digest via Head, that digest is verified, and the image is then fetched by the original unresolved reference again, so the tag can be re-pointed between the two calls.

landing_point.why: The Fetch call sits immediately after the cosign Validate call, and the digest already computed for the check at client.go:321 is the natural carrier for pinning the fetch; anyone reading 'TOCTOU between verification and image fetch' looks for the fetch that follows verification.

fix_sites.entry_point: (*xpkg.CachedClient).Get via the public xpkg.Client interface - a Go library API, no HTTP route or CLI command

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The cache-hit path returns package content without calling the validator, and the code itself documents that as a deliberate trade-off with the reason (verification would require disabling the cache or caching whole OCI images), so a solver argues the cache is by design and outside the TOCTOU.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Caching must keep working: a cache hit returns parsed content with no registry round-trip, PullNever must not fall through to a fetch, and the returned Package must still report the tag as Version/ResolvedVersion with the resolved digest only in Digest. A fix that verifies or fetches on every Get breaks offline/PullIfNotPresent installs.

O6_input_shapes: tag reference (registry/name:tag) - digest must come from Head and then be the fetch target
digest reference (registry/name@sha256:...) - already pinned, Head is skipped
reference rewritten by an ImageConfig so the resolved ref differs from the requested ref

O7_producer.where: pkg/xpkg/cache.go:83-109 (FsPackageCache.Store), fed from the store goroutine at pkg/xpkg/client.go:342-345

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A cache hit parses and returns package content and reports the resolved digest without ever calling the cosign validator, so content cached before verification was enabled (or stored by a pre-fix racy fetch) is served as if verified
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The code documents the skip explicitly as an accepted trade-off and explains why it cannot be closed without disabling caching

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The verification config is looked up on the ImageConfig-rewritten reference, so a path rewrite moves the image out of the prefix its verification ImageConfig matches and the signature check is silently skipped
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Verification arguably applies to the image actually pulled, and an operator can write the ImageConfig against the rewritten name
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, pkg/xpkg/config.go:80-100 and one call site at client.go:234

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second fetch consumer in the same package, e.g. a dependency-resolution helper that pulls each package dependency image by tag and parses it with the same parser
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Package metadata already exposes GetDependencies at client.go:147-153 and dependencies are installed as separate packages, so a maintainer adding a dependency fetch helper would copy this Get body and inherit the tag-then-verify ordering

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second Fetcher implementation (e.g. an oras-backed fetcher, or a FetchVerified convenience) that resolves and fetches in one call without pinning the digest
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The package already ships two Fetcher implementations behind the interface (K8sFetcher at fetch.go:54, NopFetcher at fetch.go:204), so a third is a natural contribution

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a cache entry format that records whether the stored content was verified, returned by Get
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The in-code comment at client.go:306-315 names exactly this gap, so a maintainer hardening the TOCTOU would plausibly extend the cache format

O9_family: Signature-verification bypass (CWE-345, insufficient verification of data authenticity) through a time-of-check/time-of-use race (CWE-367) on tag-to-digest resolution

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.9 (go.mod:3); modules with go.sum and gomod2nix.toml for nix builds
O10_build.project_tests: pkg/xpkg/client_test.go: TestClientGet at :223 (~30 table cases incl. SuccessWithVerification at :832 and ErrorVerificationFails at :910), TestClientListVersions at :1060, TestExtractPackageYAML at :1236; mock Fetcher/Validator/Cache (client_test.go:44-120) keep the path runnable offline

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Pin the digest only on the tag path where Head was called, leaving digest refs, ImageConfig-rewritten refs and the cache-hit path as they are.
